document: Solar MEMS Technologies ACSS Advanced Coarse Sun Sensor datasheet
notes: Datasheet: 2 orthogonal axes, FOV +-60 deg, accuracy < 3 deg (3-sigma, not calibrated), 15-30 V, 3 mA, analogue 15-pin micro connector, double redundancy, 2500+ units in orbit since 2019, 200 krad gamma, operating temperature -45 to 85 C (the qualification range is -55 to 105 C).

name: CubeSat Sun Sensor
document: SSBV CubeSat Sun Sensor datasheet version 1h
notes: CMOS PSD detector behind a pin-hole, FOV 114 deg, accuracy < 0.5 deg with the supplied calibration algorithm (statistical basis not stated), update rate > 10 Hz (limited by the customer ADC), 5 analogue channels (four position voltages plus reference), 9-way Nano-D, 5 V. Mass is the declared '< 5 g' (upper bound); power 0.05 W = 10 mA at 5 V (derived from '< 10 mA'). 10 krad is the component-level total dose; qualification 20 g rms and 1000 g shock. Flew on TDS-1 (2012).

name: Digital Sun Sensor (+-32 deg)
notes: Two sensor heads (one per redundant side), 2 measurement axes each, FOV +-32 deg x +-32 deg, accuracy +-0.1 deg (statistical basis not stated), LSB 0.125 deg, 28 +-7 V input (other ranges available), typical dissipation 1 W, serial output of two 10-bit words plus a sun-presence bit. Mass derived as the sum of the declared nominal masses: sensor 0.3 kg + electronics 2.2 lb (0.998 kg). Size is the sensor head (96 x 94 x 53 mm); electronics 190 x 127 x 53 mm. The +-64 deg version is mentioned (five heads give 4 pi sr) without separate values.

document: Redwire Coarse Sun Sensor (Cosine Type) datasheet (02/2021)
notes: Datasheet (02/2021): rad hard > 100 krad (Si), 2.8 x 1.9 x 1.2 cm; baffles can be provided to restrict the FOV (nearly any FOV by a custom baffle).

document: Redwire Coarse Sun Sensor Pyramid datasheet (02/2021)
notes: Datasheet (02/2021): with baffles 3.5 x 3.5 x 1.7 in (89 x 89 x 43 mm), 0.29 lb (0.13 kg) nominal, rad hard to more than 100 krad (Si).

document: Bradford Space Coarse Sun Sensor datasheet (Jan 2017)
notes: Datasheet (Jan 2017): self-redundant pentagon sensor in production since 1975, near-hemispherical FOV, individual detector outputs to the AOCS (current or voltage), variants with a 5th detector on the pyramid top and strap-on baffles. No numeric values in the text.

document: Bradford Space Cosine Sun Sensor datasheet
notes: Datasheet: FOV 160 deg full cone, qualified for LEO in the Van Allen belts; typically eight to twelve sensors per platform, the sun vector follows from three illuminated units. No other numeric values in the text.

document: Bradford Space Cosine Sun Sensor Redundant datasheet
notes: Datasheet: FOV 180 deg full cone, internally redundant, qualified for long GEO, MEO and LEO missions. No other numeric values in the text.

document: Bradford Space Fine Sun Sensor datasheet
notes: Datasheet: analogue quadrant detector, two axes, four quadrant output voltages plus a sun-presence voltage, internal thermistor on the electronics; variants without readout electronics (Mini-FSS) and a filtered variant. No numeric values in the text.

document: Bradford Space Mini Fine Sun Sensor datasheet
notes: Datasheet: analogue quadrant detector, two axes, variant without readout electronics suited to small satellites, qualified for LEO in the Van Allen belts. No numeric values in the text.

name: Adcole Coarse Sun Sensor detector
reason: bare detector (no electronics, 0.13 kg with baffles, FOV 2 pi sr, accuracy +-1 deg at null); not a complete sensor unit: left out, could be added on request
